title: Covariant Ext exact sequence in an abelian category
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category with small Ext groups [def-pc-ext], let $M$ be an object of $\mathcal A$, and let $0\to A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C\to0$ be a short exact sequence. For natural numbers $n,m$ with $n+1=m$, the sequence $\operatorname{Ext}^n(M,A)\to\operatorname{Ext}^n(M,B)\to\operatorname{Ext}^n(M,C)\to\operatorname{Ext}^m(M,A)\to\operatorname{Ext}^m(M,B)\to\operatorname{Ext}^m(M,C)$ is exact. The arrows within a degree are postcomposition with $f$ and $g$, and the connecting arrow is postcomposition with the extension class of the short exact sequence.

source.place: Tag 06XP, Section 13.27, paragraph following Lemma 13.27.3; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/06XP

proof.text: Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.covariantSequence_exact to M and the short exact sequence, in degrees n,m with n+1=m. The definition covariantSequence spells out the six arrows as postcomposition, including the extension-class boundary. The witness forms covariant_sequence_exact₁ and covariant_sequence_exact₃ used in the item are the corresponding exactness statements.
